name: Haruki-kun to Asobou
source:
Despite being a boy, Haruki loves his older brother a lot.
When they're alone, he decides to show off the shorts he bought for the occasion.
Seeing not only the shorts, but also his smooth thighs, Haruki's brother can't hold back anymore...

translation:
虽然是男孩，春树却非常喜欢哥哥。
两人独处时，他决定展示自己特意买来的短裤。
哥哥看到的不仅是短裤，还有他光滑的大腿，再也无法忍耐……
